No AWS row moves: Decart revenue is in the low tens of millions and no Trainium uplift is quantified anywhere. Logged news moves since 2026-11-17: none (driver_news.json lists only this deal request; taken as above). No leg value effect. (4) Timeliness: the 2026-10-29 pre-print consensus (src 66, 67) is no longer used; reference and the Q4 guidance_check rows move to post-print Zacks (FY2026 $7.80, FY2027 $10.78, FY2028 $14.37 EPS; FY2026 sales $829.33B, Q4 implied $245.3B, ours $244.6B inside the $240-247B guide).
